title: •Chewie, Enraged
caption: •Chewie, Enraged (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While present at a site with Han or Leia, Chewie is Heroic and, unless hit, may be forfeited to satisfy all remaining attrition and battle damage against you. Once per game, may ▲ Kashyyyk or _Falcon_.
lore: *Smuggler*. Very few people need to be told that angry Wookiees should be given a wide berth.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4 (third box ARMOR with value); deploy 4 / forfeit 6. The wiki stub has deploy=6 and forfeit blank — wrong, the slip prints 4 over 6; the stub's game_text_note also mentions FORCE-ATTUNED, which the slip does not print. Leading yellow LS pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2}. _Falcon_ italic on the slip. Icon column: pilot, warrior (printed card also has maintenance — slip column replaces it). Credit printed in italic centred BELOW the text box (credit_bottom, as vs11 Lord Vader), not in the margins. Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). Lore: 'Smuggler' visibly bold on the 350 px scan → *Smuggler*. Only a 350 px scan; copyright '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' legible enough on it. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 349 px). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
credit_bottom: Original concept by Peter Jacobson, PC Volunteer Award 2006
